## 8fbc7756d37f

### Reproduced shortcut and validator/sampler mismatch

A rival rule that transforms only monochrome four-connected components whose bounding box is **exactly one isolated 2×2 block** matches all 4/4 usable canonical pairs and all 32/32 sampled generator outputs. The same 32-sample schedule was used; every sample was unique and passed the target validator.

The target validator nevertheless accepts a 5×6 grid containing one solid 2×3 color-4 rectangle, because it recognizes two overlapping filled 2×2 windows and their union covers all nonzero cells. The default sampler cannot produce this case: its `_free` placement logic isolates exact 2×2 blocks.

On the accepted 2×3 rectangle, public Racket authority scans both overlapping windows and writes the union of their anti-diagonals:

```text
input motif:       reference motif:   rival motif:
4 4 4              0 4 4              0 0 0
4 4 4              4 4 0              0 0 0
```

Thus the exact-2×2-component rival leaves the output blank while the authority produces four color-4 cells. This is a **validator-accepted domain case omitted by the default sampler**, not merely an out-of-domain probe.

Source identity: generator SHA-256 `28e54759969936d8e3fe80814cb227f744de2055581b85238a47c2063747403d`; executed/catalog rule hash `c1ed1e88bc9c`. Exact input, Racket output, rival output, hashes, empty validator-findings list, canonical fit, and 32-sample comparison are in `checks/audit/8fbc7756d37f/comparison.json`; raw public receipts are in the same directory.

The target also fails standalone lint for a missing `RULE_HASH` pin and singleton axes. No patch was applied; this section is findings only.

triage.reason: Brief-reviewed routine repair; complete lesson/axis/portable-test and interruption feedback retained. Portable-test and incremental-evidence subset now implemented; resume/semantic-policy changes remain separate work. Both audits and unscored solves retained.

## 8fbc7756d37f

**Classification: reproduced shortcut and validator/sampler mismatch.** No audit-target files were changed.

Generator SHA-256 `28e54759969936d8e3fe80814cb227f744de2055581b85238a47c2063747403d`; executed/catalog rule hash `c1ed1e88bc9c`.

A plausible rival transforms only monochrome four-connected components that are exactly isolated 2×2 blocks. It fits **4/4 canonical pairs** and **32/32 fresh medium generated cases** (seeds 0–7, sample indices 0–3; 32 unique inputs; all validator-clean). The ordinary sampler constructs isolated 2×2 objects, so it never teaches overlapping-window behavior.

The validator nevertheless accepts a 5×6 input containing a solid 2×3 color-4 rectangle: the two overlapping filled 2×2 windows cover every nonzero cell. Racket authority emits the union of both anti-diagonals—four color-4 cells—while the exact-component rival emits none. Thus this is a validator-accepted discriminator omitted by the sampled distribution, not an arbitrary out-of-domain attack.

Evidence: `checks/audit/8fbc7756d37f/comparison.json`, `input.json`, `racket.json`, and the 32-case `generated_racket.json`.

triage.reason: Accepted source-bound findings-only audits; exact reproductions retained. Generator contract/teaching defects are repair candidates, no-issue outcomes remain bounded; duplicates do not count as new defects.
